mlm:name: GeoPixel
description: GeoPixel is the first end-to-end high-resolution remote sensing large multimodal model (RS-LMM) supporting pixel-level grounding, enabling fine-grained visual perception by generating interleaved masks in conversation. It supports up to 4K HD resolution and is designed for high-precision RS image analysis, outperforming existing LMMs in single-target and multi-target segmentation tasks.
pretext_training_type: Grounded conversation generation with pixel-level grounding
masking_strategy: Adaptive image partitioning with instance and semantic masks; <SEG> token for mask association
pretraining: Pretrained on InternLM-XComposer-2.5 (7B) with LoRA for LLM, fixed CLIP ViT-L vision encoder, grounded vision encoder initialized from SAM2 weights. Pixel decoder, LoRA parameters, vision projector, and language projector are trainable.
backbone_modifications: Scaled CLIP ViT-L/14 to base resolution 560
Adaptive image divider for dynamic partitioning
Partial LoRA applied to vision tokens
processing:lineage: Cropped to 800x800 patches; Area threshold for instance selection; Marker placement based on mask area/shape

mlm:hyperparameters.learning_rate: linear warmup to 0.0003, then cosine decay
mlm:hyperparameters.image_resolution: up to 4K HD, 800x800 patches, 560x560 global view

benchmarks.application: Remote sensing image understanding with pixel-level grounding
Referring expression segmentation in aerial imagery
